channel.title: WTF
channel.description: Updates for WTF — Whiskey Tango Foxtrot

item.title: WTF 0.10.0
item.description:
Your own dictionaries

  • Make a dictionary — Settings › Dictionaries › New…, from scratch or as a copy of any built-in. Type a word per letter; it saves as you go.
  • Lives in iCloud Drive — each dictionary is a small JSON file in iCloud Drive › WTF › Dictionaries. Edit it in any text editor, and it shows up on your iPhone too.
  • Missing letters show a faded Empty until you fill them in; the picker shows how many are done.
  • Dictionary choice is now per device — the Mac can stay on NATO while the phone shows off the silly one.

item.title: WTF 0.9.1
item.description:
Keycaps, refined

  • Space and symbol rows now use the same key, legend and word styling as letters, faded to 20% — they read as filler, not as a different kind of thing.
  • Letter keys get a hairline of light along the top edge and shade along the bottom, plus a soft drop shadow that deepens in dark mode.

item.title: WTF 0.9.0
item.description:
Removing a recent entry — or clearing them all — now reaches your other devices. Before, sync only ever added; now iCloud is the source of truth after the first merge.

Softer input field — 8pt corners to match the keycaps — and a simpler clock icon for recents.

item.title: WTF 0.8.0
item.description:
Your recents and settings now sync through iCloud. Spell something on the iPhone, and it's in the Mac's recents moments later — and they survive deleting and reinstalling. Nothing to sign in to; it uses the iCloud account you're already on. Turn it off in Settings if you'd rather not.

Type weight on the Mac now matches the iPhone.

item.title: WTF 0.7.0
item.description:
New setting: Repeat first letter in word — choose between W WHISKEY and W HISKEY, where the keycap is the first letter. Settings → General.

Words are UPPERCASE by default now, with a little more letter-spacing so caps breathe. Title case and lowercase are still there.

Refined keycaps — no outline; a lit top edge and a soft shadow instead, so they read as keys in light and dark mode. Legend and word now share the same size and weight in SF Pro Rounded.

Same model as the iPhone app, which is on TestFlight.

item.title: WTF 0.6.0
item.description:
Refined app icon — a more convincing keycap, with the legend sized like a real Magic Keyboard key.

Lighter popover buttons — the settings and quit buttons are now bare, with a subtle circle that appears on hover. Slightly larger icons, more room between them.

Under the hood — the app now runs on the same shared model as the upcoming iPhone version. Your recents and settings carry over unchanged.

item.title: WTF 0.5.0
item.description: WTF has an app icon: a keycap, backlit in dark mode.

item.title: WTF 0.4.1
item.description: Settings now reliably opens in front (WTF shows in the Dock while Settings is open). New menu bar icon option: List.

item.title: WTF 0.4.0
item.description: Settings is now tabbed (General, Dictionaries) with a centered title, like System Settings.

item.title: WTF 0.3.1
item.description: Verifies the automatic update pipeline end to end. No functional changes.

item.title: WTF 0.3.0
item.description: First build with automatic updates. Also: word style setting, recents menu in the input field, Escape to dismiss.
